name: scos-memory-fabric
description: Connects Claude Code to the SCOS Memory Fabric via the mcp-gateway service, exposing scos_recall, scos_status, scos_explain, scos_user_model, scos_memory_graph, scos_correct and scos_forget. Includes /scos-recall, /scos-status, /scos-explain commands, a scos-memory skill, and a SessionStart hook.

gateway_url.title: SCOS gateway URL
gateway_url.description: Public MCP endpoint, fronted by cloud-control-plane (services/cloud-control-plane) which authenticates your API key and proxies to mcp-gateway. Defaults to the hosted fleet deployment.

bearer_token.title: SCOS API key
bearer_token.description: Your own per-user API key (scos_live_...), issued at signup and listed under Settings -> API Keys in the SCOS portal, or the SCOS_BEARER_TOKEN value in ~/.hermes/scos.env on this machine. Each key is scoped to its own tenant workspace -- your memories are never shared with other users' keys.

tenant_id.title: Tenant ID (legacy, optional)
tenant_id.description: No longer required for authentication -- cloud-control-plane derives your tenant/principal from the API key itself. Leave blank unless a specific deployment still expects it (SCOS_TENANT_ID in ~/.hermes/scos.env).

principal_id.title: Principal ID (legacy, optional)
principal_id.description: No longer required for authentication -- cloud-control-plane derives your tenant/principal from the API key itself. Leave blank unless a specific deployment still expects it (SCOS_PRINCIPAL_ID in ~/.hermes/scos.env).
